results.title: Fuel prices fall ahead of midterms, but diesel remains $2 higher year over year - FleetOwner
results.snippet: # Fuel prices fall ahead of midterms, but diesel remains $2 higher year over year. Diesel and gasoline prices edged lower ahead of the midterms, but trucking still faces steep year-over-year fuel cost increases. * U.S. diesel and gasoline prices declined, marking a shift after weeks of elevated fuel costs. For the first time in American history, the average gas price held above $4 on Election Day.
